title: Inference Exit Mode Taxonomy and Dashboard Spec
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current dashboards conflate different inference termination reasons (timeouts, overloads, model rejections, client cancellations, transport errors) so oncall and platform teams cannot prioritize remediation effectively. This ticket defines a pragmatic, implementation-ready taxonomy of 'exit modes' (canonical termination reasons), required trace/log enrichment, metric derivations, and a Grafana dashboard spec + alert mapping to make failure signals actionable.

Scope: - Define canonical exit modes (e.g., deadline_timeout, p99-queue_drop, model_reject, runtime_oom, kv_cache_miss_error, grpc_4xx, http_5xx, client_cancel) with example signatures and priority for remediation. - Specify tracehook attributes and span tags to carry exit_mode and inference_stage. - Define Prometheus/ClickHouse metrics and derived rates (per-route exit_mode rate, latency histograms broken out by exit_mode, SLO exposure). - Design dashboard panels: heatmap of exit_mode by route/model, time-series stacked by exit_mode, top-N traces table anchored to spans with tags, and error drilldown with suggested runbooks. - Map alerts to severity and noisy/low-actionable filters. - Provide sample queries and PRD links for instrumentation changes.

Non-goals: Rewriting existing SLOs or implementing sampling policies (this ticket only specifies and prototypes queries/dashboards and the trace/log enrichment contract).
acceptance_criteria: A canonical exit_mode list with unique machine keys and human descriptions exists and is reviewed by SRE and Runtime teams.
Tracehook spec (span attribute names and types) is reviewed and a small SDK patch created that injects exit_mode on terminal spans.
Grafana dashboard JSON draft with at least 6 panels (overview, heatmap, per-route breakdown, latency-by-exit, top traces, runbook links) in the observability repo.
Prometheus/ClickHouse sample queries validated against prod-like dataset showing separation of timeouts vs model_rejects.
Oncall playbook entries for the top 3 actionable exit_modes (deadline_timeout, overload_queue_drop, model_reject) are written and linked from the dashboard.
Updated cost estimate and rollout plan for adding exit_mode to 100% of production inference spans is documented.
No unresolved security concerns about PII leakage from added span tags (security review explicit if needed).

observability_signals: Span tags: inference.exit_mode, inference.stage, model.version, route.id, kv_cache_hit
Logs: enriched log lines with trace_id, span_id, exit_mode, request_size, token_count, runtime_os_error
Traces: terminal span must attach HTTP/gRPC transport code and model response status (ok/rejected/timeout)
grafana_panels: Overview: single-number panels for total inference errors (24h) and % errors by top three exit_modes
Heatmap: exit_mode frequency matrix (route x exit_mode) with configurable time window and p95 latency overlay
Time-series: stacked exit_mode rates per minute with annotation for deploys and capacity changes
Latency distribution: histogram of latency by exit_mode (use latency_seconds_bucket and overlay baseline SLO target)
Top traces: table of recent terminal spans with exit_mode, route, model.version, duration, and link to full trace
Runbook panel: markdown block with short remediation steps and links to longer playbooks for each exit_mode
tracing_instrumentation: Add span tag 'inference.exit_mode' on terminal spans. Allowed values: deadline_timeout, queue_drop_overload, model_reject, runtime_oom, transport_4xx, transport_5xx, client_cancel, unknown
Add span tag 'inference.stage' with values: request_ingest, routing, queue, model_exec, post_process
Ensure trace context is propagated through queue and worker handoff so trace links are preserved for multi-hop processing
Implement a small SDK helper that sets exit_mode from exception class or transport status, with a fallback to 'unknown'
log_enrichment: Modify HTTP/gRPC server middleware to emit structured log fields: trace_id, span_id, exit_mode, transport_status_code, upstream_node
Add a low-overhead mapping layer that translates internal runtime exceptions to canonical exit_mode strings before logging
Write log ingestion pipeline rule (Loki/Elastic/ClickHouse) to extract exit_mode and populate an error_index table for quick queries
alerting_mapping: P0 / Pager: sustained cluster-level queue_drop_overload rate above threshold (configurable by dedicated pool)
P1 / Page if: deadline_timeout spike > 3x baseline for 5m for a given route (indicates regressions or perf cliffs)
P2 / Email: model_reject rate increases for a specific model version (may be quality/regression) - route-level summary
Noise filter: transport_4xx spikes that correlate with a single client IP should generate a ticket but not page on first occurrence
queries: PromQL example: sum by (route, exit_mode) (increase(inference_exit_mode_count[5m])) / sum by (route) (increase(inference_request_count[5m]))

ClickHouse example: SELECT route, exit_mode, count() AS c, quantile(0.99)(duration_ms) FROM inference_errors WHERE event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY route, exit_mode ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 50
Trace query: find traces WHERE span.tag.inference.exit_mode = 'model_reject' AND duration > 2000 ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
Kusto-like example for logs: inference_logs | where exit_mode == 'deadline_timeout' | summarize count() by route, bin(timestamp, 1m)

comments: 2026-02-14 Aisha Patel: Initial taxonomy doc posted. Focused on reducing ambiguity between 'timeout' and 'queue drop' which currently share the same metric bucket.
2026-02-20 Liam Chen: Opened SDK PR #287. Instrumentation approach adds a single tag and a helper to map exceptions -> exit_mode. Needs review from Runtime team for performance overhead.
2026-02-23 Sofia Martinez: Validated sample ClickHouse queries on staging logs. queue_drop_overload correlates strongly with sustained inflight spikes in dedicated pools.
2026-03-02 SRE review (Jordan Park): Suggest adding a noise-suppression rule for client_cancel to avoid paging on user-side cancellations (edge-case).

2026-03-07 Runtime-Perf (Mei Wong): Concern about adding string tags to terminal spans at high cardinality. Proposal: use a limited enum and emit a numeric exit_code metric for aggregation to avoid high-cardinality cardinality issues.
2026-03-09 Liam Chen: Updated spec to include numeric exit_code metric mapping (0..10) in addition to the string tag; added note about sampling rate for full trace payloads.
decision_log: 2026-02-25 Decision: Use a small fixed enum for inference.exit_mode (8 values) rather than free-form strings. Rationale: limit cardinality in tracing backends and metrics label space.

2026-03-06 Decision: Implement both a low-cardinality 'exit_code' metric for dashboards and a human-readable 'exit_mode' tag for traced terminal spans. This buys usability and aggregation performance.
2026-03-10 Decision: Defer changes to sampling policy to a follow-up ticket; first rollout will attach exit_mode to 10% of traces by default while metrics are emitted for 100% of requests.
